name: Hawaii
overview: The state income-tax system provides a refundable low-income renter credit; owner property-tax relief is county-specific.

programs.name: Credit for Low-Income Household Renters
programs.maximumBenefit: $50 per qualified exemption, including an additional exemption for qualifying age-65+ taxpayers.
programs.formulaSummary: Flat amount times qualified exemptions, subject to qualifying rent and other eligibility conditions.
programs.application: Complete Schedule X Part I with N-11/N-15; 2025 calendar-year claims deadline December 31, 2026.
eligibilityNotes: Hawaii presence for more than nine months.
Qualifying rent must exceed $1,000 after exclusions.
Dependent, tax-exempt rental-property, reimbursed-rent, and subsidy restrictions apply.
programs.programYear: 2025 rent and income, claimed on 2025 return.

programs.name: Real estate taxes in Hawaii itemized deductions
programs.ageRule: No age test applies to the real estate tax component.
programs.incomeDefinition: Hawaii adjusted gross income can affect the overall itemized deduction. The federal adjusted gross income test in Worksheet A-2 controls its separate income or sales tax component.
programs.incomeLimits: Hawaii applies no separate income limit to eligible real estate taxes on Worksheet A-2. An overall itemized deduction limit can apply.
programs.maximumBenefit: The full qualifying amount of real estate taxes enters Form N-11 line 21b before the overall itemized deduction limit.
programs.formulaSummary: Worksheet A-2 includes eligible real estate taxes paid. Hawaii does not apply the federal state-and-local tax deduction cap to the state worksheet.
programs.application: Enter eligible real estate taxes on Worksheet A-2 line 6 and carry the total from line 9 to Form N-11 line 21b if itemizing.
eligibilityNotes: Use eligible taxes paid on owned nonbusiness real estate, including amounts the lender paid to the taxing authority from escrow in 2025.
interactions: Form N-11 applies any overall limit after adding itemized components. Compare the resulting total with the Hawaii standard deduction.

sources.title: 2025 Hawaii Form N-11 instructions for line 21b

researchNotes: County homeowner circuit breakers and exemptions are local rather than a uniform statewide owner benefit.
The credit uses qualified exemptions, not a percentage of rent.
